result.note: Tests the March 2026 motion against Speaker Om Birla: its rarity and how the Lok Sabha disposed of it.

questions.prompt: In March 2026, the Lok Sabha took up a no-confidence motion against Speaker Om Birla. Consider the following statements:
items: It was only the fourth such motion against a Speaker in India's parliamentary history.
The motion was defeated in a recorded division of members.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: The motion was rejected by voice vote, not in a recorded division. The opposition INDIA alliance, led by the Congress, filed it, citing repeated denial of floor time to its members.
questions.source: rejected a no-confidence motion against Speaker Om Birla by voice vote on Tuesday, only the fourth such motion in the country's parliamentary history
